ServiceSaasMicrosaas.title: SaaS & MicroSaaS
ServiceSaasMicrosaas.lead: A validated internal solution can become a product other companies pay to use.

sections.title: What's included
sections.body: We turn internal tools and validated ideas into SaaS or MicroSaaS products — from the first MVP to a platform ready for other customers.

sections.title: When it makes sense
sections.body: When a solution built to solve an internal problem turns out useful enough to become a product, or when the idea already exists and the first version just needs to be built.

ServiceSaasMicrosaas.ctaBody: Tell us the idea — we'll help think through the first step to validate it before building everything.
